fact: BCT Circular to banks and financial institutions no. 2024-02 of 29 January 2024 sets marketing, pricing and pre-contractual disclosure rules, with specific internal controls for products marketed through information and communication technology channels; payment institutions are excluded.
title: Circular to Banks and Financial Institutions No. 2024-02 of January 29, 2024
publisher: Banque Centrale de Tunisie (text via RegAlert)
